fixture_key_comparison_only.exact_fragment:
# Ignore only cantillation and meteg for exact pointed-form comparison.
# Retain every vowel, dagesh, shin/sin dot, consonant and maqaf.
def key(text):
    # strips ta'am, meteg, sof pasuq / nun-hafukha (verse-boundary marks,
    # not part of word identity) and U+034F; keeps maqaf (it affects
    # segmentation) and every vowel/dagesh/shin-dot.
    return ''.join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize('NFC', text)
                   if not (0x0591 <= ord(c) <= 0x05AF
                           or ord(c) in (0x05BD, 0x034F, 0x05C3, 0x05C6)))

meteg_authority.exact_fragment:
# CODIFIED RULE (user directive: "codify that difference so we can apply it
# everywhere"; 2026-09-19/20): a METEG (ga'ya) on the qamats letter
# immediately before the vetted sheva marks the qamats GADOL (the ga'ya
# keeps the big vowel from reducing) and the sheva falls to R4-long logic.
# Evidence: all user gadol rulings carry the meteg (Ex 6:9 shome'u, kavru
# x2, arkhu); all user katan rulings lack it; Winsbacher agrees gadol on
# 95/95 testable meteg cases and is overridden by user gold on arkhu+kavru.
# Also codified (ARECH family, user ruling): length-forms ending in HOLAM
# (archo) = KATAN; the lengthened-verb form ending in SHURUK (arkhu) = GADOL.
PROVENANCE_M = {'type': 'codified_rule', 'name': 'meteg-gaya qamats gadol',
                'date': '2026-09-19/20',
                'authority': 'user directive; consistent with Ish Matzliach '
                             'legend + all user rulings + Winsbacher testable cases'}

meteg_dispatch.exact_fragment:
if not fixture:
        # meteg-ga'ya rule (codified 2026-09-19/20, see PROVENANCE_M):
        # qamats + METEG on the letter immediately before the vetted sheva
        # -> qamats GADOL, sheva via the engine's R4 long-vowel logic.
        applied = False
        for r in records:
            idx = r['letter_index']
            if idx == 0 or 'qamats quality unknown' not in r['reason']:
                continue
            P = idx - 1
            PL = parsed['letters'][P]
            if PL['vowel'] != 'qamats' or '\u05bd' not in PL['marks']:
                continue
            if not applied:
                result['rule_applied'] = 'meteg_gaya'
                for q in result['qamats']:
                    if q['letter_index'] == P:
                        q['quality'] = 'gadol'
                        q['evidence'] = 'meteg_gaya_rule'
                        q['provenance'] = dict(PROVENANCE_M)
                applied = True
            r['engine_decision'] = {k: r[k] for k in ('label', 'rule_id', 'reason', 'confidence')}
            # the meteg is the rule's evidence: bypass the engine's
            # meteg-downgrade policy on letter copies for _r4_long
            letters_nc = [dict(L) for L in parsed['letters']]
            letters_nc[P]['meteg'] = False
            letters_nc[idx]['meteg'] = False
            engine._r4_long(r, letters_nc, parsed['segments'], idx, P, 'qamats_gadol')
            r['provenance'] = dict(PROVENANCE_M)
            r['reason'] += " | meteg-ga'ya rule: qamats GADOL (codified, user directive)"
            r['notes'] = [n for n in r['notes'] if 'PENDING-GOLD' not in n]
            r['notes'].append("codified meteg-ga'ya rule; engine_decision retained")
        if applied:
            records.sort(key=lambda r: r['letter_index'])
            return result
        return result

r4_long.exact_fragment:
def _r4_long(rec, letters, segments, i, P, v):
    """R4 for a LONG preceding vowel."""
    L = letters[i]
    Pl = letters[P]
    rec["features"]["vowel_before"] = v
    rec["features"]["vowel_before_letter"] = P
    rec["features"]["meteg_before"] = Pl["meteg"]
    # PENDING-GOLD (user 2026-09-16): the vay-yE-C-vU class (vav-consecutive
    # with a vowelless third radical, e.g. Gen 37:25 vay-yEsh-vU) is not
    # settled: na (vay-yE-sh@-vU) vs nach (vay-yEsh-vU). Mark uncertain
    # until the user rules. Deliberately narrower than the (retracted) A2.
    if (i >= 2 and i + 1 < len(letters)
            and _same_segment(segments, i - 2, i)
            and _same_segment(segments, i, i + 1)
            and letters[i + 1]["vowel"] is None
            and letters[i - 2]["base"] == "ו"
            and letters[i - 2]["vowel"] == "patah"
            and letters[i - 1]["base"] == "י"
            and letters[i - 1]["vowel"] == "tsere"
            and letters[i - 1]["dagesh"]):
        rec.update(
            label="uncertain", rule_id="R4", confidence="low",
            reason="vowelless third radical after a preformative tsere "
                   "(vay-yE-C-vU class, e.g. Gen 37:25): na vs nach is "
                   "pending the user's gold ruling")
        rec["notes"].append("PENDING-GOLD: na (vay-yE-sh@-vU) or nach "
                            "(vay-yEsh-vU) - user to rule")
        return
    main = _main_accent_letter(letters, segments, i)
    if main is not None and main == P:
        rec["features"]["stress_evidence"] = "taam"
        rec.update(
            label="nach", rule_id="R4_ACCENTED_LONG", confidence="high",
            reason="preceding long vowel (%s) carries the word's main "
                   "accent; following sheva nach" % v)
    elif main is not None:
        rec["features"]["stress_evidence"] = "taam"
        rec.update(
            label="na", rule_id="R4", confidence="high",
            reason="preceding long vowel (%s) is unstressed (word accent "
                   "on letter %d)" % (v, main))
    else:
        rec["features"]["stress_evidence"] = "heuristic"
        # Segment-bounded (handoff fix 2026-09-18): the no-ta'am heuristic
        # must read the current maqaf segment's length and final letter,
        # not the global word's. Identical behavior for single-segment
        # words (seg_end == len(letters)-1 there).
        seg_start, seg_end = _segment_of(segments, i)
        n = seg_end + 1
        last = letters[seg_end]
        final_heavy = (last["vowel"] is None
                       or last["vowel"] in LONG_VOWELS)
        if P >= n - 2:
            rec.update(
                label="uncertain", rule_id="R4", confidence="low",
                reason="long vowel (%s) may be the tonic syllable; no "
                       "ta'am to confirm stress" % v)
        else:
            conf = "high" if final_heavy else "medium"
            rec.update(
                label="na", rule_id="R4", confidence=conf,
                reason="preceding long vowel (%s) in a non-final syllable; "
                       "default stress is final (no ta'am present)" % v)
    # meteg policy: only the ta'am-less heuristic branch is blocked by meteg
    if rec["features"].get("meteg_before") or L["meteg"]:
        if (rec["rule_id"] == "R4"
                and rec["features"].get("stress_evidence") == "heuristic"):
            rec["label"] = "uncertain"
            rec["confidence"] = "medium"
            rec["reason"] += (" | meteg present; v0 policy: meteg alone "
                              "does not decide")
            rec["notes"].append("meteg recorded as a feature; not used as a "
                                "rule in v0")
        else:
            rec["notes"].append("meteg recorded as a feature; not decisive here")

accepted_rules.exact_fragment:
## Rules (priority order, first match wins)

    R2   sheva under the last base letter of a graphic segment
         -> nach, high. Overrides everything (single-letter segment -> R1).
    R8   Divine Name (qere perpetuum): yod-sheva + heh + vav + heh
         (the Tetragrammaton in all its spellings) -> the initial sheva
         is nach, high. Never read as written; tradition classifies the
         initial sheva as nach.
    R1   sheva under the first base letter of a graphic segment
         -> na, high. Single-letter particle: na, medium.
    R7   sheva on the consonant IMMEDIATELY after a segment-initial
         conjunctive-vav bearing shuruk -> nach, high (וּC closed
         syllable). Attested: וּלְ (Ex 18:8), וּבְ (Deut 6:5), וּקְ /
         וּכְ (Deut 6:8-9); any letter in this position. Does not fire
         when that letter carries a full vowel (וּבִשְׁעָרֶיךָ is R4).
    R3   two shevas on consecutive base letters (same segment):
         first -> nach, high; second -> na, high.
         Gated by A1 for the first-of-pair after an EXPLICIT long vowel;
         plain U+05B8 does NOT block R3 (engine fix rev 6: first of pair
         -> nach regardless of qamats quality).
    R5   sheva under a dagesh-bearing letter -> na, high. begadkefat at
         syllable onset after a silent sheva (dagesh qal possible): capped
         at medium (in well-formed text pre-empted by R3).
    R6   sheva under the first of two consecutive identical base letters
         (same base AND same sin/shin dot) -> na, high.
    R4   vowel-quality + stress rule, below.
    DEFAULT  no rule fired -> nach, medium (safety net).

## R4 in detail

Preceding vowel (scanned back within the segment across vowel-less mater
letters):

- hataf -> nach, high (hataf is short).
- qamats_qatan (explicit U+05C7) -> nach, high.
- plain qamats (U+05B8) -> UNCERTAIN, low, "qamats quality unknown".
  Q1 exception (user gold): in the exact forms לְבָבְךָ / לְבָבְכֶם the
  plain U+05B8 before the medial sheva is gadol -> na, high. No other
  plain U+05B8 is affected (prefixed variants like בִּלְבָבְךָ excluded).
- patah / segol / qubuts / hiriq_haser -> nach, high.
- tsere / holam / shuruk / hiriq_male (long) -> stress logic:

  Stress (main accent = last disjunctive in the segment, else the
  segment's only ta'am; a pre-tonic conjunctive does not count as tonic):
      - main accent on the long vowel's letter -> nach, high
        (R4_ACCENTED_LONG; includes nasog-achor-style retraction)
      - main accent on a different letter -> na, high
      - no ta'am: default stress is final; long vowel not in a
        final-syllable position -> na (high if the final syllable is
        heavy — closed or long-voweled — else medium). Possibly-tonic
        defensive branch -> uncertain.
